name: Kanzaki Kouichirou
source:
Best friend at his own pace.

Yuuichi has been his close friend since entering school.
He's always smiling at his own pace, unfazed by his surroundings.
For that reason, he should be in the best position to play the role of reprimanding Yuiichi, who tends to get emotional, but because of his own pace, the timing of his tsukkomi is often off, and in fact he is not very useful.
However, He is not to be taken it lightly because he is sometimes very sharp.
Standing over 190cm tall, he often bumps his head against the lintel at the entrance.

[From Pikopiko's website]
